name: medical-interfaces-demo
description: Demo: HL7, DICOM, GDT simulieren und per REST integrieren

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run download-dicom --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R client/dist/. public/
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
